transcript.text: Alright, let's get this coordination huddle started. We need to finalize the quarterly communications-equipment audit for Wednesday — it'll be in either the Comms Annex or the Admin Hall. Before I publish the facility and schedule order, I need to hear from both of you. Signal officer, facilities officer — are there any updates or issues affecting either facility or the audit schedule that I should know about? The base access desk and facilities control room both need this finalized before close of business Tuesday, so let's sort it out now.

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag an important update. I confirmed with the audit team this morning that the audit requires exactly four uninterrupted hours and a dedicated UPS-backed circuit for the entire period. This requirement is in the team's technical checklist but has not yet been added to your planning slide. We need to make sure whichever facility we choose — Comms Annex or Admin Hall — can meet that UPS-backed circuit requirement for a full four-hour block.
